compute_log_ndtr: compute the log of the normal CDF for a PyTorch tensor using log_ndtr
compute_log_ndtr_float64: compute the log of the normal CDF for a float64 tensor with higher precision thresholds
compute_asymptotic_series: compute the asymptotic series approximation of log CDF for large negative x values
test_log_ndtr: test the log_ndtr function with float32 and float64 input tensors
review_log_ndtr_asymptotic_series: review the _log_ndtr_asymptotic_series helper function and its configurable series_order parameter
